title: Renewal negotiation with Riley
objective: Renew with a 10% increase without giving away free add-ons.
expect: Unilateral concession (dropped to $109,000 with nothing in return): ask for something back (2-year term, faster payment)
Riley claims AI Analytics was promised free: memory says it is a paid add-on with a 30-day free trial (May 14 call)
Pro-rated cost for 15 seats over 6 months at $1,200/seat/year = $9,000

utterances.text: Riley, it's great to connect. As we discussed last week, to keep supporting your team's growth, the renewal proposal includes a 10% price adjustment for next year, bringing the total to $120,000.

Taylor, a 10% increase isn't going to fly with my CFO right now. We have strict mandates to cut software spend. If you want us to sign today, we need to keep the price exactly flat at $109,000. Otherwise, we're going to have to evaluate other tools.
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: I completely understand the pressure from your CFO. Let me see what I can do... Okay, if it gets the deal signed today, I can keep the price flat at $109,000 for this renewal.

Great, glad we could agree on that. Also, I was looking through my notes from our Q2 check-in. You mentioned that the new AI Analytics module would be included for free when we renewed. Can you confirm that's in the contract?
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: Oh, um... I talk to a lot of clients about the AI module. I don't recall exactly what I promised back in Q2. I'll have to take your word for it.
Perfect. Last thing: if we acquire that small agency in March and need to add 15 extra seats halfway through the contract, what is the exact pro-rated cost we should budget for those seats?
utterances.speaker: A

utterances.text: So, 15 seats... normally it's $1,200 per seat annually, so halfway through the year... give me a moment to do the math.
